summary: Repair plugin compatibility, standard installation, lint, documentation and review evidence
description: Address the explicitly requested Mail Drop publication gaps against the central Obsidian checklist. Native reception remains an explicit externally installed dependency, with standard three-file installation functioning without it. Official preview is a separate authenticated external gate.
acceptance: Manifest requires at least Obsidian 1.5.7 and standard main.js/manifest/styles installation starts without a missing executable error; direct app drags use an explicitly configured installed receiver; official lint, tests, isolated test-vault checks and bundle scans pass; SECURITY and CONTRIBUTING exist; authenticated preview is recorded honestly before claiming Community readiness.
